niazmorshed2007/reanimate.caption:
This Claude skill can reverse engineer any animation 🤯

It's called Reanimate. Give it a website link, an MP4, a screen recording, or a GIF, and it breaks the animation down into every detail: when each element moves, how long it takes, and how it speeds up and slows down. Then it rebuilds the whole
